company.name: KNOWRON
company.tagline: Empowering industrial workers with an AI-based digital assistant.
company.description:
🧠 What if every technician had the knowledge of the entire company right in their pocket?
With KNOWRON, that vision becomes reality.
KNOWRON is an AI-powered assistant for smartphones and desktops – purpose-built for service technicians, industrial workers, and other deskless professionals.
Our solution delivers your organization’s knowledge exactly where it’s needed: on site – fast, intuitive, and voice-driven.

Key Features:
🔍 Natural Language Search
Find answers in seconds – through AI-powered search across manuals, protocols, and internal documents.

📚 Closing Knowledge Gaps
KNOWRON identifies frequently asked questions and automatically generates tailored, company-specific knowledge articles.

🛠️ Smart Instructions & Training
Create step-by-step instructions and interactive training modules – for seamless onboarding and continuous learning.

📝 Automated Documentation
Generate standardized, audit-ready service reports via voice input – fast, accurate, and effortless.
